title: locheria hirsuta

It is a shrub-like plant native to tropical regions, known for its medicinal properties and uses. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
